sources.title: MCE — MCP Code Execution - GitHub
sources.snippet: MCE (MCP Code Execution) is a production-grade MCP server that transforms Swagger/OpenAPI specs into LLM-native Python functions. It provides dynamic discovery, inspection, and sandboxed Docker execution to minimize context window usage and maximize security for AI-driven API orchestration.

sources.title: Models | OpenCode
sources.snippet: Here the full ID is provider_id/model_id. For example, if you're using OpenCode Zen, you would use opencode/gpt-5.1-codex for GPT 5.1 Codex. If you've configured a custom provider, the provider_id is key from the provider part of your config, and the model_id is the key from provider.models.
